action.initiative_title: Proyecto de Ley del Impuesto sobre Determinados Servicios Digitales. (621/000005)

original_vote_xml.gap: Official URLs and normalized source record exist, but no independently content-addressed copy of original vote-specific XML bytes exists.

totals.absence_distinction: NULL normalized absence means not normalized; source payload reports 0. NO VOTAN is a distinct ballot label and is not absence.

claim_policy.public_domain_identity_policy: retain official public identity; exclude only secrets, private session state, and workstation traces

geography_assessment.action_geography_basis: candidate inference from the Spanish Senate national legislative proceeding; the vote row has no populated territory_id

indicator.label: PIB por habitante en estándar de poder adquisitivo

limitations: The 2020 annual observation overlaps the 2020-10-07 action date and is excluded from pre/post roles.
The retained observations span the COVID-19 pandemic and many unmeasured political, social, demographic, and economic changes.
One pre point and one post point do not establish statistical association, trend break, counterfactual, or causal effect.
No human semantic or geography review has been recorded.
The current Eurostat release is a baseline capture; a later real release is required to demonstrate supersession.
The original vote-specific XML bytes are not independently content-addressed; only the normalized official source record is content-addressed.
A vote on the remainder of a bill is not proof of implementation, collection, compliance, fiscal yield, economic effect, or social outcome.

participant_contract.cross_database_reference_contract: logical TEXT IDs plus actor_graph_release_id and actor reference digest; no SQLite foreign key crosses database files
participant_contract.export_projection_canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON; sorted object keys; compact separators; Unicode not forced to escapes; no trailing LF; same participant SQL order
participant_contract.public_identity_retention: all 264 official names, seats, groups, ballot choices, source links, and logical actor references remain retained
participant_contract.source_projection_canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON array; SQL order CAST(seat AS INTEGER), seat, member_name; sorted object keys; compact separators; fields seat, member_name, person_id, group_code, vote_choice, source_id, source_url, source_snapshot_date
participant_contract.vote_source_locator_contract: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer to exact original raw_payload member_votes array index matched by seat, official_member_name, official_group_code, official_vote_choice

reader_wording.measurement: Eurostat registra 28.700 PPS por habitante para España en 2019 y 28.300 en 2021. La diferencia aritmética es -400. El año 2020 queda excluido porque su intervalo contiene la fecha de la votación.
reader_wording.status_label: Candidato preproducción pendiente de revisión humana
reader_wording.summary: Este emparejamiento usa una votación real del Senado y observaciones reales de Eurostat. Es un candidato metodológico L1, no un enlace de resultado publicado.
reader_wording.warning: No usar para afirmar asociación estadística, causalidad o efecto; atribuir resultados; clasificar actores; asignar mérito o culpa; ni evaluar éxito, fracaso, legalidad o corrupción.

policy.public_domain_identity_policy: retain official public identity; exclude only secrets, private session state, and workstation traces

query_contract.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON; sorted object keys; compact separators; Unicode not forced to escapes; no trailing LF
query_contract.sql_utf8: SELECT l.vote_event_id,l.initiative_id,l.link_method,l.confidence,l.evidence_json,v.vote_date,v.legislature,v.session_number,v.vote_number,v.title,v.totals_present,v.totals_yes,v.totals_no,v.totals_abstain,v.totals_no_vote,v.totals_absent,json_extract(v.raw_payload,'$.totals_absent') AS raw_totals_absent,v.source_id,sr.source_record_id,sr.source_snapshot_date,sr.content_sha256 FROM parl_vote_event_initiatives l JOIN parl_vote_events v USING(vote_event_id) JOIN source_records sr ON sr.source_record_pk=v.source_record_pk WHERE l.initiative_id=? AND v.source_id=? AND sr.source_snapshot_date=? ORDER BY v.vote_date,v.session_number,v.vote_number,l.vote_event_id

canonical_preimage.observation_role_projection: strict_pre_eligible if period_end < action_date; strict_post_eligible if period_start > action_date; otherwise overlap_excluded

query_contract.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON; sorted object keys; compact separators; Unicode not forced to escapes; no trailing LF; arrays retain SQL order
query_contract.definitions_and_releases_projection_tran: direct SQLite row mapping; preserve SQLite JSON scalar types
query_contract.definitions_and_releases_sql_utf8: SELECT d.indicator_id,d.source_id,d.dataset_code,d.indicator_code,d.frequency_code,d.unit_code,d.methodology_version,d.revision_policy,r.indicator_release_id,r.source_snapshot_date,r.source_updated_at,r.source_url,r.source_content_sha256,r.source_bytes,r.comparison_state FROM indicator_definitions d JOIN indicator_releases r USING(indicator_id) WHERE r.indicator_release_id=? ORDER BY d.indicator_id,r.indicator_release_id
query_contract.observation_projection_transform: direct SQLite row mapping; retain value_decimal and raw_value_json as TEXT; append temporal_role using inclusive action-date interval rules
query_contract.observations_sql_utf8: SELECT o.indicator_observation_version_id,o.period_label,o.period_start,o.period_end,o.value_decimal,o.value_text,o.source_status_code,o.uncertainty_state,o.revision_ordinal,o.revision_state,o.raw_cell_index,o.raw_value_json,e.indicator_observation_evidence_id,e.source_content_sha256,e.raw_path,e.value_json_pointer,e.status_json_pointer FROM indicator_observation_versions o JOIN indicator_observation_evidence e USING(indicator_observation_version_id) WHERE o.indicator_series_version_id=? AND o.indicator_release_id=? ORDER BY o.period_start,o.revision_ordinal DESC,o.indicator_observation_version_id
query_contract.series_projection_transform: parse dimensions_json with JSON parser, remove dimensions_json, emit parsed value under dimensions; preserve remaining SQLite JSON scalar types
query_contract.series_sql_utf8: SELECT indicator_series_version_id,indicator_id,indicator_release_id,stable_series_key,geography_code,geography_name,geography_system,geography_level,geography_version,dimensions_json FROM indicator_series_versions WHERE indicator_release_id=? ORDER BY indicator_id,stable_series_key,indicator_series_version_id

selection_rule.post: min(period_start), then revision_ordinal DESC, then observation ID ASC
selection_rule.pre: max(period_end), then revision_ordinal DESC, then observation ID ASC

query_contract.actor_match_key: legacy_person_id opaque exact equality after TEXT coercion
query_contract.actor_sql_utf8: SELECT n.actor_id,v.node_version_id,v.release_id,v.canonical_label,v.identity_state,v.source_id,v.source_record_id,v.source_url,v.source_content_sha256,v.provenance_state,v.attributes_json FROM actor_graph_node_versions v JOIN actor_graph_nodes n USING(actor_id) WHERE v.release_id=? AND v.source_id=?
query_contract.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON; sorted object keys; compact separators; Unicode not forced to escapes; no trailing LF
query_contract.legacy_person_id_projection_type: preserve parsed attributes_json JSON scalar type; current audited values are JSON numbers
query_contract.match_coercion: coerce participant person_id and parsed legacy_person_id to TEXT only for exact equality
query_contract.participant_sql_utf8: SELECT seat,member_name,person_id,group_code,vote_choice,source_id,source_url,source_snapshot_date FROM parl_vote_member_votes WHERE vote_event_id=? ORDER BY CAST(seat AS INTEGER),seat,member_name
